university.name: Philippine Women's University
university.description: Historic private university founded in 1919 and recognized in 1932 as the first women's university in Asia founded by Asians. Now fully co-educational despite its name. Main campus on Taft Avenue in Malate. Known for music (CHED Center of Excellence), nursing, nutrition and dietetics, pharmacy, hospitality management, and teacher education. Uses a trimestral academic calendar.
university.tuition: Approximately P30,000-P60,000 per trimester (varies by program; allied health and laboratory programs tend higher; contact admissions for current rates)
